Need help with a federal agency? We got you.

This Saturday, Team Crockett will be at the Jubilee Food Pantry from 11 AM to 2 PM. If you’ve been trying to get answers, need support, or just don’t know where to start, stop by and see us.

We’re here to serve you!

My heart is with the families impacted by today’s devastating explosion and fire in Oak Cliff.

As recovery efforts continue, we are praying for those who lost loved ones, those who were injured, the families who have been displaced, and those who are still unaccounted for.

If you are looking for a family member or need assistance, a family reunification center has been established at W.H. Adamson High School. The American Red Cross is assisting residents and can be reached at 1-800-733-2767.

Inflation has hit the highest level in THREE years. Gas prices are up. Food costs are up. Working Americans are struggling to make ends meet.

Meanwhile, Trump is focused on turning the White House into a UFC venue, and pushing for a commemorative $250 bill with his face on it.

People are struggling to survive, and this administration is acting like they are filming an episode of a reality show.

You deserve better.


ABC News (@ABC)

A key inflation gauge accelerated in April to the highest le

Three federal judges stepped in and blocked Alabama Republicans from using yet another congressional map designed to weaken Black representation.
 
The fact that Black voters are still having to fight this hard for fair representation in 2026 is outrageous. Republicans need to spend less time trying to dilute Black voting power and more time doing the jobs they were elected to do.


NBC News (@NBCNews)

BREAKING: Federal court blocks Alabama’s congressional map that creates an additional GOP-fri

On Memorial Day, we honor the brave servicemembers who answered the call and never made it back home.

My heart goes out to your loved ones. Thank you for your sacrifice, service, and strength. We will never forget what they gave for this country.

We still haven’t had a real hearing on the rise of white supremacist violence, the lives lost, or the extremist groups empowered by dangerous Republican rhetoric.

But somehow, Republicans found time to hold a hearing claiming the Southern Poverty Law Center is “manufacturing hate.”

Meanwhile, they’re defending an almost $2 billion taxpayer-funded slush fund that could put money in the pockets of January 6 extremists — including people tied to white supremacist groups that attacked our democrac

Working families are struggling to afford groceries, gas, rent, and healthcare — taxpayers should not be forced to bankroll political revenge tours and payouts for Donald Trump and his cronies.

That’s why I introduced the STOP TRUMP Act — to make it clear that taxpayer dollars are not a personal slush fund for presidents, political loyalists, or extremists who participated in an attack on our democracy.

They swear they care about “waste, fraud, and abuse” — meanwhile Trump is trying to turn $1.7 BILLION in taxpayer money into a MAGA slush fund for his loyalists.

J6 rioters and people accused of crimes like assaulting police officers and lying to Congress could get rewarded while working families — struggling to put food on the table, fill up their gas tanks, and make ends meet — foot the bill.

This is corruption in broad daylight.


ABC News (@ABC)

President Trump is expected to drop his $10

The American people are watching the courts abandon precedent, ignore the Constitution, and bend over backwards to give Donald Trump whatever he wants.

Every ruling like this further erodes people’s faith in institutions that are supposed to be independent, credible, and grounded in the law.

Video

It quite literally couldn’t be clearer that this man does not care about you. “Not even a little bit” — his words, not mine.

Working families are struggling to pay for groceries, keep the lights on, and fill up their gas tanks…and he couldn’t care less. 

You deserve better.


Acyn (@Acyn)

Trump on Iran War:

Reporter: What extent are Americans’ financial situation motivating you to make a deal?

Trump: Not even a little bit. I don't think about Americans’ financial situation

Video
  





—

Referring to the highest-ranking Democrat in the House — who is also a Black man — using white supremacist, slavery-era language is NOT acceptable. Full stop.

The lows this Congress continues to sink to are historic. Some people are determined to try and drag us backwards through both their rhetoric and legislation, but the reality is WE ARE NOT GOING.

If folks actually knew their history, they’d remember the Confederates lost — and will keep losing.


Headquarters (@HQNewsNow)

GOP Rep. Jen K

This should not be a partisan issue — but Republicans have made it one.

This is the same party that claims to stand for law and order, transparency, and protecting women and girls. But they couldn’t even be bothered to show up and hear directly from Epstein survivors.

Their complicity is loud — but their absence was even louder.

To every survivor: thank you for continuing to speak out. Our systems have failed you but we hear you, we believe you, and we will keep fighting until you get the jus

To the mothers, grandmothers, bonus mamas, and all the women who love on us, sacrifice for us, and hold everything together—we see you and we thank you. The world keeps turning because of y’all. Happy Mother’s Day 💐

Over 3 million Virginians spoke loud and clear in a free and fair election — and now, because MAGA Republicans didn’t like the outcome, the Virginia Supreme Court struck down the results of the election. 

Let’s call this what it is: voter suppression. They keep losing when people actually vote, so instead of changing their policies, they keep trying to silence the voices of the people. 

The power belongs to the people — and every attempt to silence voters only exposes how afraid they are of th

Every day, I am amazed by @RepLaMonica’s bravery. Despite facing 17 years in prison for conducting oversight of ICE, she remains committed to protecting the people she serves. I was proud to tell @marieclairemag why I will stay on the frontlines with her.

Let’s not ignore the timing here. This raid comes just weeks after Virginia voters rejected Trump-backed efforts to rig the midterms, and it is not the first time Trump and his allies have openly targeted Black women they view as political opponents — including New York Attorney General Letitia James, Lisa Cook, and Congresswoman LaMonica McIver.
 
Americans are tired of watching y’all play political games just to generate headlines while the actual attacks on democracy keep getting ignored. Whe

A BILLION dollars.

Not for lowering costs. Not for helping families. Not for anything that actually makes the cost of living more affordable. 

A billion dollars for Trump’s ballroom.

While folks are out here struggling to keep up with rent, groceries, gas prices, utilities, and rising healthcare costs — this is what Republicans are prioritizing.


The New York Times (@nytimes)

Breaking News: Senate Republicans proposed $1 billion for security measures around President Trump’s ballroom projec

Happy May Day to the people who keep this country going. Today, workers took to the streets demanding that this country put workers over billionaires. Workers are the backbone of this country — and this economy doesn’t work without them. They deserve dignity, fair pay, and time to actually live and thrive, not just survive.
Join me as we celebrate some of TX-30’s most talented student artists. Our 2026 Congressional Art Competition Showcase will take place on May 9, 2026 at 11am. RSVP: tx30.us/artshowcase
